title: His mother and father and their deaths
summary: His mother's influence; she died in 1961 while he was on tour with Sam Cooke, his father died in 1950 while he played the Pentagon.

blocks.x: No regrets. So was your mother an influence on your life? Very much so, yeah. It seems that.
